elements_not_encoded.reason: The Yes/No question routes to x-ray/referral or analgesia; it names no diagnosis, so no rule. See Could not model.

elements_not_encoded.text: Yes • Do cervical spine x-ray. • Refer to doctor.

No • Give paracetamol 500mg-1g 4-6 hourly (up to 4g in 24 hours) for up to 5 days. If no response, give ibuprofen2 400mg 8 hourly with/after food for up to 5 days. • If no better after 5 days and no arm pain, refer for physiotherapy. If pain ≥ 3 months, assess and advise 76. • If no better after 6 weeks, arm pain, weakness/numbness develops or pain worsens, do cervical spine x-rays and refer.

elements_not_encoded.reason: "May have" finding is optional, not a criterion.

elements_not_encoded.text: If no better after 6 weeks or worsens, refer to doctor.

1Do not mix Ringer's lactate and IV ceftriaxone. 2Avoid if peptic ulcer, asthma, hypertension, heart failure, kidney disease, pregnant. If patient also taking aspirin, advise to wait at least 30 minutes after taking aspirin before taking ibuprofen.

judgment_calls.decision: Two check_for tasks and two Urgent priority rules: neck pain, and arm or hand symptoms (trigger Finding of upper limb).
judgment_calls.alternatives: Split into two files (not allowed: one .lisp per page).

judgment_calls.topic: Recent neck injury and x-ray unavailable
judgment_calls.decision: Encoded as recent neck injury AND (abnormal cervical spine x-ray OR neurological symptoms). 'x-ray unavailable' is not representable, so the rule fires less often than the page intends.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Recent neck injury alone (fires more often); (no (procedure x-ray)) as a proxy for unavailable (rejected as invented proxy).

judgment_calls.decision: Thumb pain OR catching/locking of finger; 'worse with thumb/wrist movement' not representable, so thumb pain alone fires probable tenosynovitis.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Thumb pain AND (catching or locking) would miss de Quervain-type thumb pain.

judgment_calls.decision: 'severe pain/swelling' read as severe pain or severe swelling; deformity unqualified.
Arthropathy probable from joint warm/tender/swollen or Limitation of joint movement, within an upper-limb finding.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave 'unable to do all actions comfortably' unencoded.

judgment_calls.decision: purple/red rash = Purpuric rash OR Erythematous rash.
The probable meningitis rule uses stiff neck + any one sign, without requiring neck pain; the priority rule requires neck pain.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Require neck pain in the diagnosis rule too.
